_note: V3 고정 화풍 2종. 캐릭터 image_prompt에 {style_prompt}로 주입됨.

masako.label: 마사코 스타일
masako.description: 지브리풍 70% + 실사풍 30% — 손그림 수채화 질감, 따뜻한 자연광, 반사실적 인물 비례
masako.base_style_prompt: Studio Ghibli inspired painterly illustration, soft hand-painted brushwork, warm natural color palette, gentle diffused natural lighting, atmospheric depth with soft bokeh, semi-realistic human proportions and facial expressions, watercolor-textured shadows, lush detailed background elements, emotional warmth and nostalgic cinematic quality, Korean drama cinematic framing, subtle realistic skin and fabric texture
masako.negative_prompt: flat anime, hard manga ink lines, screen tone, chibi, full photorealistic, 3d render, harsh high contrast, cold desaturated, western comic, heavy black outlines, digital flat cel shading, neon colors, ugly, deformed, extra limbs
masako.bg_prompt_suffix: no people, empty scene, Studio Ghibli inspired painterly background, soft atmospheric depth, warm natural lighting, hand-painted landscape textures, cinematic Korean drama setting

noir_oil.label: 누아르 유화
noir_oil.description: 4색 팔레트 누아르 유화 — deep black / warm amber / steel blue / dark crimson 포인트 (씬별 오브젝트 1개)
noir_oil.base_style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black shadow and darkness, warm amber primary light source, steel blue secondary shadow and city cold, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition
noir_oil.negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark
noir_oil.bg_prompt_suffix: no people, empty scene, oil painting thick impasto, noir chiaroscuro, four-color palette: deep black deep black shadow, warm amber light source, steel blue city cold, Korean drama cinematic setting
noir_oil.crimson_rule: single dark crimson accent on ONE emotional object per scene only — do not spread across the image
